（DeepSeek Harness）Web UI 增强：目录链接直接打开为可浏览的文件夹页。Personal UX fixes for the DeepSeek Harness web client.
# better-dsh
English | 简体中文
Built against DeepSeek Harness (dsh) `0.2.1-rc.3`.
## What's changed
### Directory links open properly
Clicking a directory path in chat (or `present`-ing a directory) used to show only "This path is not
a regular file and has no content to display" in the right sidebar, with no buttons in the top-righ
t corner. The preview header only renders after `stat` returns file info, and directories never get
The preview header only renders after `stat` returns file info, and directories never get that far.
With this plugin:
- Clicking a directory opens a folder view: a file list (folders first) with file sizes, plus up-one

-level and refresh. Clicking a file still opens it in the normal preview.
- Opening files works the
same as before. If the probe fails, times out, or the Remote isn't available, it falls back to the o

riginal behavior. Details in docs/folder-browser.md.
- The sidebar's `+` menu gets a "Browse folders
" card for starting from the workspace root.
### Mission Control
Sessions, background jobs, approvals and scheduled tasks were spread across the sidebar, the session
header, the Automation page and the right Sidebar. Mission Control pulls them into one right-Sideba
r, the Automation page and the right Sidebar. Mission Control pulls them into one right-Sidebar tab:
- **Needs you**: approvals, plan reviews, questions and finished-but-unseen sessions, ordered by urg

ency.
- **Running**: active sessions and background jobs, with job counts and the last activity time

.
- **Scheduled**: active scheduled tasks, ordered by the next run.
- Click any row to open its sess
ion; the three counters at the top are running / waiting / scheduled.
It reads the existing Session, status, jobs and schedule client surfaces and degrades to empty lists
when a service is absent, so the folder tab is unaffected. It is read-only for now: refresh and nav
igation work; stopping jobs, approving and running a schedule on demand are not wired yet.
### Fonts & sizes
Some 0.2 builds do not render the built-in "More font settings" row. This plugin adds a General-sett
ilds do not render the built-in "More font settings" row. This plugin adds a General-settings panel:

- Interface, code and terminal font families, plus their sizes (10–22, 10–16, 10–20 px).
- Leave an

input empty for the default; separate fallbacks with commas.
- Reset clears the three families and r

estores 14 / 11 / 13 px.
- Writes through DSH's own `ui-theme` settings, so it persists and applies

11 / 13 px.
- Writes through DSH's own `ui-theme` settings, so it persists and applies immediately.
### Theme Studio
Settings → General now has an Obsidian-style theme gallery:
- Obsidian, Nord, Catppuccin, Rosé Pine, Tokyo Night and Solarized, each with light and dark variant

s.
- The theme is an alias-token layer applied through `ctx.theme.overrideTokens`; DSH's own light/d

ark/system preference stays authoritative and the palette follows the OS scheme.
- A "DSH default" c
ard removes the layer. The selected custom theme is remembered in this browser.
## Install
Install from the **Plugins** page with:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or point the installer at a local clone. No build step: `client.js` is the final artifact.
## Compatibility
Verified on DSH `0.2.1-rc.3` (first developed against `0.2.1-rc.2`). If a future release changes the
tab-type registry, the Remote namespaces or the `settings.general.item` slot, the affected feature
may stop loading; the Console logs are prefixed with `better-dsh:`.
The plugin only touches the Web client UI: it registers no tools, writes no session events and does
not change model input.
